items.t: What Is Teradyne (TER) Bringing To Edge AI With Omnyx Edge?
items.sum: Teradyne (NasdaqGS:TER) introduced Omnyx Edge, an inline board test platform for physical and edge AI devices. The new system extends the existing Omnyx family, which previously focused on high performance computing and data center applications. items.t: Teradyne to Present at the 2026 UBS Global Technology and AI Conference
items.sum: NORTH READING, Mass., November 16, 2026--Teradyne, Inc. (NASDAQ:TER) today announced that Greg Smith, Chief Executive Officer, is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference on Monday, November 30, 2026, at 4:15 PM MST.
